“It’s come to my attention,” {he(TargetCharacter)} bristles, “that {Lover} and your heir have struck up a romantic correspondence. Keep {Heir} away from {firstName(Lover)}! I don’t like {him(Heir)} one bit!”

{Character} throws a datapad on your desk. “That’s a love letter,” {he(Character)} barks. “One of dozens, from {Lover}. Have you any idea the situation you’ve put {PlayerHouse} in?”

“I won’t apologise!” {Heir} counters. “I love {him(Lover)}!”

“Your advice was life-saving,” {he(Heir)} reflects later, safe and sound.

“How did you get back?” you ask.

“I just did what you always told me:"
“I told them I was your heir. Saved my life.”
“I regret it cost your treasury dearly...”
“I refused to sit idly, and escaped!”

“The gunshot to my leg was not planned; they were trying to slow me down.”

“It’ll make a courageous scar,” you smile.
“I told them I was a nobody.”
“They dunked me in engine run-off, and threw scrap at me. When they got bored I slipped away. I just hope nobody finds out...”
